description: This file defines a styled Button component using React, class-variance-authority for variant styling, and Radix UI Slot for composability. It includes variant and size customization options, and exports the Button component along with style variants.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A React component that renders a styled button element with customizable variants and sizes, supporting rendering as a different component via 'asChild'.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A React forwardRef component that renders a button or Slot component with applied styling variants based on props.
